mathematics.assertion_tested: For each tested (curve, G' of prime order q in [40,160]) and each d <= d_int + 1: the set of m with a (d,1) relation on <G'> equals the predicted endomorphism multipliers U_d = {alpha mod q : N(alpha) <= d} \ {0}, for every d < d_int (conjecture C2 in the small-q regime); and every m has a relation at d = d_int (linear algebra).
mathematics.coefficient_domain: F_p exact (numpy int64 with p < 2^14, all products < 2^41; Python ints for polynomials and number theory)
mathematics.conventions: Relation Y*psi(X) + phi(X) = 0 with deg phi, deg psi <= d on all M=(q-1)/2 distinct pairs (x_k, x_{mk}); d_min(m) = least such d (exact rank over F_p, monotone in d, binary search); interpolation threshold d_int = least d with 2d+2 > M.
inputs: 8 curves: CM D in {-3,-4,-7,-8,-11} and 3 generic, p in [2^13,2^14), q || N, seeds MASTER_SEED=20261027 + 100 i
non_claims: A failure here refutes C2 in this regime only

randomness.generator: Python random.Random (prime, curve, twist and point selection)
